changelog: Removed To-Do App Engine: Deleted SQLite task database, background alarm scheduler, and reminder receivers to make AntiBot lean, fast, and light
Restored Clean Notes & Docs: Returned Notes screen to direct, lightweight view with instant search and zero tab switching overhead
Streamlined AI Assistant Bubble: Refocused palette to 5 essential tools (Point & Draw screen, Screen reader, Quick actions, Cross-device share, Chat workspace)
Bounded File Streaming: Optimized local file reading with streaming buffer to prevent memory exhaustion on large project files
